blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. Material deployment: Flare 0x4a771cc1a39fdd8aa08b8ea51f7fd412e73b3d2b holds 95.6029% of supply (Pharos census). At Flare block 72460043, the proxy's verified HexTrustUSDV2 implementation 0x35151ba1c19b31cc258787a414c93bbe77251147 returned hasRole(BLACKLISTER_ROLE, 0x7b30ea52ef44d87acf25dd52f803069676b50ea5) = true and hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, 0xa688c5d5a13f1e5c8103e1b787bfe7d6f9ed6d2c) = true. The implementation exposes addBlacklist(address)/removeBlacklist(address) under BLACKLISTER_ROLE, gates transfers on the blacklist, and exposes burnBlackFunds(address) under BURNER_ROLE, which burns the entire balance of a blacklisted account. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by EOA 0xb8Ce31ad8bAD26e88Db17e68F695C64f67AD31EB on the proxy. pause()/unpause() exist under PAUSER_ROLE. Ethereum 0xf8750b54d86be7ae9e32b4a0c826811198d63313 (0.6086%) independently returned the same active blacklisters at Ethereum block 26224776. Songbird (3.7885%) is a sub-threshold native deployment and is disclosed only. Reserve exposure (100% U.S. Treasuries and cash at Hex Trust) is upstream in principle but is not verdict-setting. The operative holder-targeted controls are the blacklist and privileged burn.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDX has three independent native issuance chains: Ethereum, Flare, and Songbird. The Ethereum and Flare V2 deployments also expose a LayerZero OFT burn/mint route with reciprocal peers. Their local delivery contracts, peers, Endpoint addresses, and issuer EOA configuration/upgrade controllers are identified, while direct MINTER_ROLE issuance and native UUPS mint-logic controls remain in Mint Authority. The exact current per-OApp DVN/executor roster, quorum, and validator controller are not established by the reviewed sources, so external validation authority remains unresolved. Songbird V1 has no callable OFT surface and remains native-only.

nativeExternalTransferReviews.rationale: The exact Ethereum and Flare proxies resolve to verified HexTrustUSDV2 implementations exposing LayerZero OFT burn-on-debit and mint-on-credit. Existing August 16 fixed-block observations establish reciprocal peers; a fresh Flare read at block 72586628 (2026-10-20T22:16:38Z, hash 0xb45e76fde9620c10a0c3df3c40a899f2ea7a697007671363e2d87862286e4488) confirms EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and peers(30101) equal to the exact Ethereum USDX proxy. Independent native issuer minting does not remove this external-validation transfer rail. This review establishes only that tier: current DVN/executor membership, quorum, emergency overrides, complete route loss scope and economic materiality remain separate. Songbird is not included and native mint capabilities are not duplicated.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: LayerZero V2 endpoint/DVN/executor validation is an external route failure domain. The exact per-OApp DVN and executor configuration, validator membership, quorum, and emergency override roster were not read; no threshold or custody claim is made.

controls.evidence: The Ethereum and Flare USDX V2 deployments use the identified LayerZero V2 Endpoint contracts and reciprocal OFT peers, so their delivery path is known. The 2026-08-28 review found no primary source in the record that resolves the current USDX-specific DVN/executor roster, quorum, emergency override roster, or controlling authority. A generic Endpoint contract type cannot stand in for those missing validator facts; this validation control therefore remains unknown. Reclassified 2026-09-01 under AUTHORITY-LADDER 9.46: the controlling party for this control is the external LayerZero V2 DVN/executor validation quorum itself, a rotating protocol-scoped operator set with no single controllerAddress to record. Its authority model is therefore validator-quorum, known but weak, graded no higher than a named issuer backend and never above a named multisig, rather than unknown. The unresolved roster, quorum, override and peer facts recorded above are unchanged; only the authority classification moved.
